question: To which revilers of sacred principles must the kaula teaching never be given?
premises: The teaching must not be given to one who reviles Shiva.
It must not be given to one who slanders the Kula Bhairava.
inference: Revilers of Shiva and of the Kula Bhairava are strictly excluded from receiving the teaching.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation of kulabhairave is compressed.
plain_english: O Goddess, it must not be given to one who reviles Shiva or slanders the Kula Bhairava.
